paper_title: One-Electron Quantum Cyclotron as a Milli-eV Dark-Photon Detector
notes: Proof-of-principle DPDM search with a one-electron quantum cyclotron in a Penning trap. Sets epsilon < 3.2e-11 (90% CL) at m_A' = 0.61227643 meV (148.048 GHz), ~75x better than XENON1T/cosmology bounds in this narrow band. The limit applies over a narrow bandwidth (~33 kHz detector bandwidth broadening the ~100-150 kHz DM linewidth, corresponding to ~±3e-10 eV around the central mass); encoded as a short flat segment spanning roughly the sensitive band. The 20-200 GHz (0.1-1 meV) coverage at epsilon ~ 8e-11 is a future projection only (Fig 5b), not included in data_points. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 3))
